name: s81_rly_38_wn

job.purpose: S81-DV frame relay master dsfd_rly_38_WN (exact-width f_prog relay of the col_h9/col_h10 frames): real hard tile, 38 b in W / out N, ck+rs S, scalar ck/rs, M5 cap, one register stage, reset pin register, recipe 4 flop-first with die hold budget
job.structural_change: S81U-3F2-D3 10-17: new exact-width S81-DV frame relay (f_prog path, 7 per h9+h10 frame pair: col_h9 x3, col_h10 x4) replacing the dsfd_rly_63_WN instances c26l padded with 25 constant bits (owner 10-17 no-ties rule). Same body as the CLOSED dsfd_rly_63_WN r4 (ot_s81_rly RSREG=1, one register stage, reset pin register) and the same faces (i W / o N / ck+rs S); flow = the native-PASS successor form of the relay family (recipe 4 flop-first, hold_budget die, no outhold/inhold pads, as dsfd_rly_266_EW r4n / dsfd_dvrly_276). Outline 12.96 x 12.96 (smallest square on the 2.16 grid that gives >= 2 M5 PG stripes per net over > 50% of the outline at m5_pg_pitch 2.7; 10.8 fails pg_spread; 63_WN is 15.12).

pin_regs.reason: OWNER RULE 19:50 opt-out (coordinator APPROVED 2026-10-15): this relay IS one flip-flop per bit between its input and output pins (ot_s81_rly: i -> r -> o, no logic); a flow pin register would add a second stage per bit and a cycle the die calendar does not price
